personal.name: Ambuj Pandey
personal.bio: I’m a multi-stack developer who builds practical products across web, mobile, and systems programming. My work spans React/TypeScript interfaces, Flutter apps, backend-heavy experiments, and developer tooling—always with a focus on clean architecture, useful UX, and reliable execution. I enjoy turning ambitious ideas into working software, whether that means shipping a polished portfolio, prototyping safety-first mobile products, or building low-level systems projects from scratch.

projects.title: Guardian Wheel
projects.subtitle: Offline-First Rider Safety App
projects.description: A Flutter safety companion for gig riders focused on hazard detection, SOS workflows, and low-signal reliability.
projects.longDescription: Guardian Wheel is a safety-focused Flutter application designed for delivery riders in low-connectivity environments. It targets crash/fatigue detection using phone sensors and outlines a mesh-alert/SOS pipeline that can escalate incidents once network returns.

projects.title: FinMitra
projects.subtitle: AI-Based Personal Finance Companion
projects.description: A Flutter app for smart expense tracking, analytics, and goal-driven personal finance guidance.
projects.longDescription: FinMitra is a multi-platform Flutter project that explores AI-assisted finance management. The app emphasizes practical money tracking, analytics, and user-centric planning features across Android, iOS, web, and desktop targets.

projects.title: AmbiDB
projects.subtitle: Console DBMS in C++
projects.description: A C++ CLI project implementing DBMS fundamentals with CRUD operations and file-based persistence.
projects.longDescription: AmbiDB is a systems-oriented C++ project that demonstrates core relational concepts through a menu-driven CLI. It includes record modeling, CRUD flows, validation, uniqueness checks, and persistent storage via structured text data.

projects.title: SheAscend
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Career Growth Platform
projects.description: A modern, AI-powered career growth platform designed to guide, empower, and uplift women through personalized learning paths and AI mentorship.
projects.longDescription: SheAscend is a modern, AI-powered career growth platform designed to guide, empower, and uplift women. It offers personalized learning, skill-building paths, mentorship support, interview prep, and smart goal tracking—helping women confidently grow, achieve, and ascend in their professional journey.

projects.title: OTT Video Player
projects.subtitle: Flutter Video Player Package
projects.description: A Flutter package providing OTT video player functionality with viewing and customization features like Netflix and MX Player.
projects.longDescription: OTT Video Player is a Flutter package that offers comprehensive video playback capabilities with extensive viewing and customization options. It provides a streaming experience similar to popular OTT platforms like Netflix and MX Player, featuring brightness and volume controls.

projects.title: Mythics
projects.subtitle: Discord Multi-Purpose Bot
projects.description: A Discord bot built with Discord.js featuring moderation tools and miscellaneous commands for server management.
projects.longDescription: Mythics is a multi-purpose Discord bot developed using Discord.js that provides essential moderation features and various utility commands. It serves as a comprehensive bot solution for Discord server management and community engagement.
